# Approval fee validation contract

The user reported an individual token approval failing with a combined balance/gas/nonce error. A loopback reproduction using the actual trading modules and ethers reproduces the error by raising only the latest base fee by one wei. This establishes a code defect; it does not establish which condition failed on the user's device.

The reviewed transaction has a fixed maximum fee. The installed ethers5.8.0 provider recommends `2 * latest base fee + priority fee`. EIP1559 limits the effective priority fee by the transaction's maximum fee minus the block base fee. A higher recommendation therefore does not itself invalidate the reviewed transaction. This change conservatively requires room for the full original priority fee. Sources: [EIP1559 specification](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1559), [ethers fee data documentation](https://docs.ethers.org/v5/api/providers/provider/#Provider-getFeeData), and installed `@ethersproject/abstract-provider/src.ts/index.ts`.

Root approved this R3 preflight before production edits, based on shipped revision `4662dbec481c4bb164c7722d2d6f26e15eeddd93`. The designated critical owner may change `src/lib/node-trading.ts` and affected financial tests. UI edits and final integration have separate owners.

- Use `lastBaseFeePerGas` from the existing `getFeeData()` request. It must be a nonnegative ethers BigNumber; missing, malformed and negative values fail closed. Existing recommended-fee validity and100gwei quote bounds remain.
- Execution requires `latest base fee + original reviewed priority fee <= original reviewed maximum fee`. Equality passes. The new recommendation and priority never replace reviewed transaction fields. No additional RPC, fee increase, retry, or automatic approval-to-sale transition is introduced.
- Preserve the original cap, priority, gas limit, amount, maximum cost, reserve, nonce and calldata through signing and signed-byte validation. Preserve chain/code/route checks, fresh simulation/quotes,2%slippage, review expiry, account/session epochs, browser locks, one-sign/one-send, durable recovery before broadcast, and unknown-outcome blocking. Batch renewal retains its original cost/fee ceilings.
- Give separate pre-sign errors for insufficient ETH including reserve, changed nonce, base plus original priority above the cap, gas estimate above the original limit, and token balance below the reviewed amount. The existing pending/latest nonce mismatch remains a distinct failure.

Acceptance uses inert wallets and loopback RPC only. Actual-module tests cover tiny base increases, exact equality, zero base, curve/v4 approvals and swaps, immutable signed fees/gas and one broadcast. Negative cases cover fee overflow, missing/malformed/negative base, insufficient balance/reserve, nonce changes, excessive gas and insufficient holdings, with no signing or broadcast. Unknown broadcast outcomes and review reuse remain blocked. Run affected financial suites and typecheck; independent verification and fresh independent review must inspect the integrated candidate before release.

There is no migration or recovery-record schema change. Reverting the source restores the prior conservative rejection. Existing pending/unknown records must still be resolved by their recorded hash. A valid latest-block fee check bounds cost; it does not guarantee future inclusion or confirmation time. The implementation owner has no production signing or deployment authority.
